original_card.question: Does a changed construction's serialized target/paid invoice independently support its claimed improvement?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently recount one changed emitted word and its complete caller, importing no constructor or pricing engine. Include target losses, owned lifetimes, native orientation and extra charges. Check existing #5633/#5708/#5717/#5719 coverage to avoid duplicate audits and preserve its exact head. Stop after the chosen missing implication; a correct root alone is not supplier admission.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.

Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

actual_scope: Independent recount, at the exact open PR heads #7637 32e3853b2250f1971932919cbbc01348cd8245be and #7633 8b885be4a553dea375303808fdfff52ed0d71019, of the step from the #7633 word to the #7637 word: (1) header and initial-chart equality, (2) the canonical digests that the PRs state, the opcode census and the ownership census, (3) the chart chronology of both complete words, (4) the MOVE rank histograms and their relation to the declared 17-call paid invoices, (5) the helper target ranks and their relation to the declared target invoices, and (6) the signs of the declared complete moments at the claim 37/10000 and around a crossing that this audit measures. No constructor, application or pricing engine of the PRs is imported.
scope_change_reason: The first experiment of the card is applied to a newer exact head. No audit of #7637 was found among the open PRs on 2026-11-17. #7637 is the first candidate of this series that ships its word and invoice inside a packed data archive and that uses the H5B construction. The #7637 invoice is a complete invoice of the word and has the same fixed caller histograms as the P104 chain, so the same recount applies.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier binds. #7637 changes the paid MOVE rank histogram of the P104 word with total rank zero and adds no helper target change. This audit binds the invoice of the claim to the emitted word bytes.
stop_rule: Stop after the word-to-invoice binding and the moment signs are resolved or one exact mismatch is found. Do not replay the native, signed, physical, ordinary, CLEAR certificate, common-U or outer stages.
evidence: verify.py passes on CPython 3.13.9 (Windows) in about 1 s: the canonical digests equal the two stated ones; the #7637 word has 78,596 events, 233 INIT and 233 CLEAR events, peak 50 owned fields and 52 labels; paid = 17 x (MOVE rank histogram of the word) + one fixed caller histogram, equal for #7633 and #7637 and equal to the one of the #7612, #7630, #7631, #7633 and #7636 recounts; targets = 17 x (helper target histogram) + one fixed caller target histogram; the native delta {1:-13,2:-46,3:-7,4:-40,5:+4,6:+43,8:+1} is recounted from the words and has total rank zero; the helper delta is empty; both words have a legal chart chronology; nine moment signs hold, with a measured crossing between 0.00370007 and 0.00370008; the derivative bounds are negative; and ten controls reject.
